title: ALX Shared Schema Definitions
$comment: Shared structural definitions only. These definitions do not verify cryptographic derivation, graph semantics, signature validity, or trace truth.

hash.description: Keccak-256 digest of a canonicalized input. 0x-prefixed, 64-character lowercase hex.

definitionLevel.description: Content definition tier for a content envelope, from opaque (no structure) to conformance-bound (schema-validated with a named conformance profile).

parentHashes.description: Declared upstream Block identities, bound into blockHash. Must be sorted and deduplicated; ordering is enforced by the protocol implementation.

attestation.description: Cryptographic claim over a blockHash. Signing is external to Block identity and does not affect blockHash computation.

error.description: Structured error or warning from a protocol operation, identified by a stable ALX error code.
